With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market.   • We are looking for a growth-focused B2B marketer with a strong foundation in paid media and marketing automation. You will be responsible for driving qualified leads to our nearshore staffing solutions using a mix of paid strategies and sophisticated HubSpot automation.

You are well-versed in Google Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and HubSpot, and you understand the nuances of marketing complex B2B services to technical decision-makers.

You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points.   • Market Research: Conduct deep analysis to identify where our target audience (technical leaders) consumes content and how best to reach them.
  • Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging B2B trends, AI integrations in marketing, and new channels for reaching technical talent buyers.
  • Sales Enablement: Advise the New Business and Account teams on recommended budgets and strategies to support their pipeline goals.
  • Campaign Execution & Management:
  • Multi-Channel Execution: Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns with a heavy focus on LinkedIn Ads (Account-Based Marketing) and Google Ads (High-intent search).
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors or agencies to ensure day-to-day execution aligns with our strategic vision.
  • Full-Funnel Analytics: Track B2B KPIs beyond just "clicks"—focusing on MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads), Cost Per Discovery Call, and Pipeline Velocity.
  • Optimization: Analyze campaign data to identify areas for improvement, such as refining audience segments (e.g., targeting specific tech stacks like React or Python users) to improve lead quality.
  • Budget & ROI Management:
  • Budget Pacing: Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize Client Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Forecasting: Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing, ensuring campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Efficiency: Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising the quality of inbound leads.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B performance marketing or media buying. Experience specifically in the Staffing, Recruiting, or SaaS sectors is a massive plus.
  • HubSpot Proficiency is Required: Must have deep experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub (workflows, landing pages, list segmentation) and CRM integration. HubSpot certifications are highly preferred.
  • Paid Media Expert: Strong experience in paid platforms, specifically LinkedIn Campaign Manager (for B2B targeting) and Google Ads.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics 4, HubSpot Reports, LinkedIn Insights Tag).
  • Strong Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex marketing data to non-marketing stakeholders.
  • Self-Motivated: Able to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

Company Benefits

  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

About Us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer‑led products, and we’re always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

About The Role

Ruby Labs is looking for a CRO Manager – someone who lives and breathes conversion optimization and delivers measurable results. In this role, you’ll have a clear mission: deliver 15% conversion rate growth in a quarter. Unlike companies where CRO specialists simply make recommendations, you’ll drive the entire process: from data analysis and hypothesis generation to creating high‑fidelity mockups, collaborating with developers on implementation, and ultimately owning the performance outcomes. At Ruby Labs, we’ve built a compensation structure that directly rewards those who exceed targets – top performers see substantial financial growth tied directly to their impact. If you’re ready to apply your optimization talents in an environment where excellence is expected and rewarded, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end optimization cycles: research → hypothesis → design → testing → rollout.
  • Conduct in‑depth funnel analysis and competitive benchmarking to identify high‑impact opportunities.
  • Design high‑quality UI/UX mockups that clearly communicate your vision and maintain brand integrity.
  • Partner with engineers to ensure flawless test implementation and deployment.
  • Maintain uncompromising attention to detail and quality throughout the process.
  • Analyze test outcomes with statistical rigor, making confident scaling decisions.
  • Document learnings and build a systematic testing roadmap for continuous conversion growth.
  • Present insights and results clearly to stakeholders, building alignment and momentum.

Qualifications

Red Bull Student Marketeer - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca. Join to apply for the Red Bull Student Marketeer - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca role at Red Bull.

Nossos Student Marketeers fazem parte do programa de embaixadores de marca mais dinâmico e capacitado do mundo. Eles entendem o público-alvo da Red Bull e são responsáveis por impulsionar a imagem da marca e a funcionalidade do produto em seu Campus e na região. O objetivo do programa Student Marketeer é alcançar novos consumidores, entusiasmar os estudantes universitários, aumentar as vendas e gerenciar a marca Red Bull em seu Campus. Isso inclui o contato direto com consumidores e clientes, convidando a experimentação de produtos, além de trabalhar em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores. Os Student Marketeers valorizam a flexibilidade em um trabalho e adoram trabalhar em um ambiente criativo.

Responsabilidades principais: SEJA UM EMBAIXADOR DA MARCA E PRODUTO. Viva e respire a personalidade da marca e os valores da empresa, representando a marca de forma excepcional através de interações diárias com os consumidores e/ou clientes. Aumente a base de consumidores convidando pessoas a experimentarem Red Bull, nos lugares certos e no momento certo, respondendo assertivamente a quaisquer perguntas dos consumidores. Crie e execute um plano personalizado e inovador no campus, envolvendo estudantes e dando vida à marca na universidade. Estabeleça uma sólida rede de contatos, através de relacionamentos com responsáveis-chave. Impulsione o envolvimento da marca em suas próprias redes sociais através de conteúdo autêntico. Trabalhe em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores.

SEJA UM ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS . Construa relacionamentos com clientes locais de pontos de venda e garanta que a Red Bull esteja disponível e visível aos consumidores. Colabore com as vendas para abrir novos pontos de distribuição para a Red Bull em seu campus e além. Aproveite os recursos relevantes do mundo Red Bull para manter a marca sempre presente nos clientes locais. Assegure a execução nos padrões de "loja perfeita".

EXCELÊNCIA NA EXECUÇÃO . Demonstre excelência na execução e atenção aos detalhes em todas as áreas de atuação. Compartilhe ideias e colabore com a equipe por meio de interações regulares presenciais e online. Planeje e relate suas atividades através da plataforma online dedicada de forma pontual e precisa. Contribua para desenvolver as plataformas de mídia da Red Bull fornecendo informações locais, tendências e oportunidades gerais.

Suas áreas de conhecimento e expertise mais relevantes para a vaga:

  • Apaixonado(a) pela marca e produto da Red Bull.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  • Personalidade carismática, enérgica, positiva e extrovertida.
  • Imerso(a) na vida estudantil, com amplo entendimento do cenário universitário, cidade e região, incluindo atividades extracurriculares e pontos de interesse.
  • Muito acessível e sociável, com capacidade de se relacionar com diferentes pessoas em diversas ocasiões.
  • Possui uma mentalidade criativa e espírito empreendedor, com alto senso de responsabilidade e iniciativa.
  • Capacidade de conciliar trabalho de meio período e estudos.
  • Afinidade e desejo de aprender e aplicar uma nova gama de habilidades, especialmente em marketing e vendas.
  • Conectado(a) com diversos grupos e indivíduos influentes no campus.
  • Carteira de motorista válida.

Requisitos adicionais: estar matriculado e cursando a faculdade referente à vaga; formação a partir de Dez/27; CNH B. Acreditamos no potencial de todas as pessoas para contribuir com ideias independentemente de gênero, raça, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, idade e deficiência. No mundo da Red Bull todas as pessoas são bem-vindas.

Observação: informações específicas sobre recrutamento podem variar; mantenha-se atento(a) às atualizações oficiais da vaga.

Como não poderia deixar de ser, aprofundou o conhecimento em TI voltado para as relações com o Fisco Estadual, desenvolvendo várias técnicas de auditoria fiscal e verificação preventiva de contingências, bem como a realização e acompanhamento de perícias em procedimentos tributários administrativos.
Com o passar do tempo, a excelência na prestação dos serviços e os resultados alcançados na esfera estadual deram ensejo ao surgimento de uma forte demanda de clientes nas áreas de tributos federais e municipais, exigindo-se um aumento do campo de atuação sem comprometer a qualidade e celeridade inicialmente propostos.
Atualmente, presta serviços não só a grandes e médias empresas sediadas no Ceará, mas também a vários grupos econômicos de outras unidades federativas, que buscam abrir novos estabelecimentos neste Estado ou melhorar seus investimentos. Atua, ainda, em outras unidades de federação, levando a experiência acumulada na solução de litígios tributários.
A SL TRIBUTOS é uma empresa diferenciada, pois detêm conhecimento jurídico, tributário, contábil e tecnologia da informação, unindo-os desde a solução de um auto de infração simples a uma complexa auditoria fiscal.

title: [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí
description:
El sábado 20 de septiembre la Plaza de la Constitución acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí

El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno.

El sábado 20 de septiembre la Plaza de la Constitución acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos.

La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción.

Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio.

El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3) a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua en una batida de limpieza ciudadana.

El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural.

La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)

description:
A Construtora Sudoeste foi contemplada pela FAPEMIG com uma concessão de subvenção econômica para a execução do projeto "ALDEA - Plataforma de gestão e otimização de condomínios inteligentes" e está com processo seletivo aberto para pesquisadores da área da tecnologia e afins.

O projeto visa desenvolver uma plataforma digital batizada de “ALDEA” que tem como principal objetivo a transformação de condomínios residenciais em condomínios inteligentes por meio de IoT e AI. A solução será usada por moradores, investidores e locadores e tem como objetivo criar um ecossistema integrado, desde a construção do prédio, locação, moradia e até a revenda das unidades, ou seja, um olhar 360 abrangendo toda a cadeia imobiliária.

É uma importante ferramenta de gestão do segmento de incorporação baseada no novo conceito de "Sociedade 5.0". A plataforma “ALDEA” proporcionará a interação dos moradores ao concierge digital que lançará mão de inteligência artificial para reconhecimento do morador durante toda a sua experiência: da portaria, por reconhecimento facial, até os serviços do dia a dia, o que vai criar uma base de uso de serviços e espaços fornecidos dentro do condomínio. Todo processo será humanizado com sintetização de voz (text to speech), criando uma conexão mais profunda a um custo reduzido. Além da reserva de espaços, contratação de serviços, recebimento de avisos e recados, liberação de visitas, pagamento e prestação de contas relativas ao condomínio e outras, como aluguel, o concierge digital será o ponto principal de interação.

Qual será o seu papel?

  • Desenvolver e manter arquiteturas de IoT para integração de sensores, dispositivos e plataformas.
  • Configurar protocolos de comunicação (MQTT, CoAP, HTTP) e gerenciar conectividade.
  • Implementar soluções de coleta, processamento e análise de dados provenientes de dispositivos IoT.
  • Garantir segurança e conformidade em redes IoT, incluindo criptografia e autenticação.
  • Monitorar desempenho e disponibilidade dos dispositivos conectados.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação industrial, smart buildings e soluções conectadas.
  • Documentar processos e criar padrões para integração de novos dispositivos.
  • Outras atividades relacionadas à função.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de TI, Eletrônica ou correlatas;
  • Experiência na área.

Experiências desejáveis

  • Desejável experiência com Protocolos IoT (MQTT, CoAP, OPC-UA), Programação (Python, C/C++, Node.js), Plataformas IoT (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub), Redes e segurança (VPN, TLS, autenticação).
  • Desejável certificações em IoT ou Cloud, Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a IoT, atuação no ramo de construção civil.

This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Seniority level

  • Internship

Employment type

  • Part‑time

Job function

  • Other

Industries

  • IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Brazil Business Development Manager
description:
Khan Academy is a fast‑paced nonprofit with a mission to provide a free, world‑class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers high‑quality, supplemental content and practice—free of charge—covering core academic subjects from Pre‑K through 12th grade and early college, with a strong focus on math and science. We serve over 200 million registered learners across 190 countries and 55 languages, and we are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, especially those in historically under‑resourced communities. For more information, please see research findings about Khan Academy and our press center.

OUR COMMUNITY

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, education, big tech companies, and startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL

Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.

Your key responsibilities

Strategic growth

  • Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities
  • Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts
  • Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies
  • Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management

Public‑sector pipeline and bids

  • Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities
  • Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models
  • Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:
  • Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts
  • Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas
  • Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria
  • Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation
  • Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners

Implementation and impact

  • Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators
  • Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections
  • Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices

Stakeholder and relationship building

  • Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy
  • When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts
  • Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams

ABOUT YOU

What you bring

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies
  • At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes
  • Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector
  • Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously
  • Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority
  • Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts
  • Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams
  • Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions
  • Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail
  • Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments
  • Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages

You would be a great fit if you have

  • Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators
  • Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities
  • Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)
  • Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes
  • Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback
  • Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education

What is nice to have

  • Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation
  • First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:

  • Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits

title: Analista de DevOps Sr
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como referência técnica em DevOps, Cloud e Confiabilidade, sendo responsável por projetar, evoluir e sustentar a plataforma DevOps e de CI/CD, além da operação de serviços críticos, garantindo segurança, disponibilidade, performance, governança e escalabilidade em ambientes multicloud e regulados. Esse profissional terápapel ativo na padronização corporativa, mentoria técnica e apoio às decisões técnicas estratégicas.

Qual será sua missão no time de DevOps?

1. Plataforma DevOps & CI/CD

  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar pipelines CI/CD corporativos e escaláveis;
  • Definir padrões de pipelines (YAML, templates reutilizáveis e quality gates);
  • Implementar estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary e rolling update), com rollback automático e rastreabilidade;
  • Criar automações e integrar pipelines com AWS, GCP e ambientes Kubernetes.

2. Cloud Platform, Kubernetes & Infraestrutura

  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes AWS e GCP, incluindo workloads containerizados e serverless;
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) utilizando Helm e Kustomize;
  • Criar e manter Infraestrutura como Código com Terraform, Ansible e AWX;
  • Planejar capacidade, escalabilidade e resiliência dos ambientes.

3. Confiabilidade, Observabilidade & Operações

  • Evoluir observabilidade 360° (logs, métricas e traces);
  • Atuar em incident response, troubleshooting avançado e RCA (Root Cause Analysis);
  • Sustentar ambientes críticos e implementar estratégias de contingência e disaster recovery.

4. Segurança, Compliance & Governança (DevSecOps)

  • Integrar segurança ao ciclo DevOps (DevSecOps);
  • Implementar e operar SBOM, Dependency-Track, Trivy e scanners de vulnerabilidades;
  • Garantir hardening de ambientes, pipelines e APIs;
  • Apoiar compliance regulatório, auditorias e governança de acessos (IAM, secrets e trilhas de auditoria).

5. Eficiência de Custos & FinOps

  • Atuar em FinOps tático, analisando custos de AWS e GCP;
  • Identificar desperdícios e propor otimizações de custo (rightsizing, reservas e desligamentos automáticos);
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios de consumo por produto ou squad.

6. Desenvolvimento & Integração com Aplicações

  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na correção de falhas de build, testes, dependências e performance;
  • Criar scripts, CLIs e ferramentas internas para automação de processos DevOps;
  • Realizar code review técnico, com foco em qualidade, segurança e operabilidade;
  • Executar correções técnicas e pontuais no código-fonte, quando necessário.

7. Liderança Técnica

  • Atuar como referência técnica do team DevOps;
  • Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores;
  • Revisar pipelines, código e padrões técnicos corporativos;
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais junto aos times de Desenvolvimento, Arquitetura e Segurança.

Como requisitos básicos, você precisa:

  • Formação em TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida como DevOps Sênior / SRE / Platform Engineer.
  • Forte domínio de Linux, CI/CD corporativo e automação.
  • Experiência avançada com Kubernetes, Docker e GitOps (ArgoCD).
  • Vivência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform/Ansible).
  • Conhecimento prático em AWS e/ou GCP.
  • Experiência com observabilidade e sustentação de ambientes críticos.
  • Scripting com Bash e/ou Python.

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga 100% presencial - Fortaleza (Centro);
  • Contratação modelo PJ;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Parcerias e descontos exclusivos (escolas de idiomas, locadoras, restaurantes, entre outros).

Facilitador Pedagógico - Boa Vista/RR

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres

Overview

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Nos últimos anos, a Venezuela tem vivido uma forte crise, ocasionando vulnerabilidade social e um contexto de emergência humanitária que se concretiza em uma intensa migração em território brasileiro. Em 2018, como resposta a essa demanda, o Governo Federal estruturou a Operação Acolhida cujo objetivo é garantir atendimento aos refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos. A AVSI Brasil integra a resposta federal à emergência humanitária venezuelana da Operação Acolhida, e neste contexto formalizou um Termo de Colaboração com o Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social (MDS) para atuar em 4 (quatro) centros de acolhida (abrigos) para refugiados e migrantes venezuelanos na cidade de Boa Vista e Pacaraima, em Roraima.

QUEM SOMOS: A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Bem como ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante o a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

  • Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;

Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene.

Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new.

JOB DESCRIPTION

ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process.

When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience.

The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

  • Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product;
  • Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools;
  • Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems;
  • Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience;
  • Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.;
  • Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements;
  • Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests;
  • Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks;
  • Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.

MUST HAVE:

  • Exceptional writing ability;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English;
  • Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs;
  • Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines;
  • Previous experience in narrative content creation teams;
  • Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire;
  • Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback;
  • Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements;
  • Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay;
  • Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media;
  • Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games;
  • Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience;
  • Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software;
  • Previous experience with VR and AR content;
  • Experience working in a studio or production company;
  • Video game industry experience;
  • A passion for Virtual Reality.

Há 88 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: Accounting Analyst (Brazil)
description:
Introduction

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.

Overview

Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures.

Arthur J. Gallagher is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Accounting Analyst to join our team for a systems implementation project, deploying JDE ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA, Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E).

This role will play a critical part in ensuring the successful integration of accounting systems, processes, and controls. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting, financial analysis, and systems implementation, with the ability to collaborate across departments to achieve project goals.

How you\'ll make an impact

  1. Systems Implementation Support:
    • Assist in the implementation and integration of new accounting systems for Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas.
    • Collaborate with IT and project teams to ensure accounting requirements are accurately captured and incorporated into system design.
    • Participate in system testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality aligns with accounting standards and business needs.
  2. Process Improvement:
    • Analyze current accounting processes and identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.
    • Develop and document new workflows and procedures related to the implemented systems.
  3. Data Migration and Reconciliation:
    • Support data migration efforts, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data transferred to the new financial systems.
    • Perform reconciliations to validate data integrity post-migration.
  4. Training and Documentation:
    • Provide training and support to accounting staff on the new system functionalities.
    • Create detailed documentation for system processes, workflows, and user guides.
  5. Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance:
    • Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS/ IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties).
    • Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements.
    • Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations.
    • Assist in preparing financial reports and analyses during the transition period.
  6. Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work closely with stakeholders across Corporate and Local accounting teams, IT, implementation partner and operations to ensure alignment and smooth implementation.
    • Act as a liaison between accounting and technical teams to address system-related issues.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, or related roles.
  • Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential.
  • Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools.
  • Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes.

Somos a ERO, uma mineradora que nasceu no coração do Brasil e cresceu levando para o mundo mais força e energia — uma força que impulsiona setores produtivos e contribui para o desenvolvimento de diferentes regiões.

title: Diretor Comercial Executivo
description:
Sobre o trabalho Diretor Comercial Executivo

Diretor Executivo Comercial - Liderança Estratégica e Crescimento de Negócios

Esta é uma oportunidade executiva que define a carreira de um líder comprovado que pode entregar resultados, inspirar equipes e impulsionar a transformação organizacional em um dos mercados mais competitivos do mundo.

O Diretor Executivo Comercial será o parceiro estratégico (business partner) de negócios do CEO e da liderança sênior, responsável por moldar a estratégia corporativa, construir equipes de alto desempenho e proporcionar crescimento sustentado em todas as unidades de negócios.

Principais responsabilidades

Liderança Estratégica Definir e executar estratégias ousadas que expandam a presença no mercado e entreguem resultados mensuráveis.

Crescimento dos negócios Impulsione o crescimento da receita desenvolvendo mercados, fortalecendo o relacionamento com os clientes e inovando serviços.

Colaboração Executiva Faça parceria com o conselho, CEO e executivos seniores para alinhar a estratégia com os objetivos de longo prazo.

Cultura e Liderança de Pessoas Construa, oriente e inspire equipes que prosperam com responsabilidade, inovação e execução.

Excelência operacional Lidere iniciativas de transformação que melhorem a eficiência, o desempenho e a escalabilidade em toda a organização.

Governança e gerenciamento de riscos Garanta conformidade, governança e resiliência operacional.

Impacto no cliente e nas partes interessadas Construa parcerias confiáveis com os principais clientes, investidores e partes interessadas para reforçar a posição da empresa como líder de mercado.

Mentalidade de inovação Antecipe as mudanças do setor, aproveite as tendências emergentes e reimagine os modelos de negócios para competitividade de longo prazo.

Qualificações

  • 20+ anos de experiência em liderança progressiva em vendas automotivas ou em um setor relacionado.
  • Histórico comprovado de crescimento mensurável de negócios e liderança de equipes de grande escala.
  • Presença executiva excepcional com a capacidade de inspirar, influenciar e alinhar em todos os níveis.
  • Expertise em estratégia corporativa, desenvolvimento de clientes e transformação operacional.
  • Sucesso comprovado na gestão da responsabilidade de P&L em organizações.
  • Forte governança, conformidade e perspicácia em gerenciamento de riscos.
  • Um líder visionário com a capacidade de reimaginar o que é possível e entregar resultados em escala.
  • Formação preferencial em Administração ou Engenharia com Especialização/Pós Graduação em TI/Tecnologia/Marketing

Por que esta posição é excepcional

Esta não é apenas mais uma função executiva - é um assento à mesa com influência em toda a empresa. O Diretor terá a plataforma, os recursos e a autoridade para:

  • Impulsione o crescimento da receita a longo prazo
  • Construa e inspire equipes de elite
  • Reimagine os produtos/serviços para conquistar mercados
  • Gerar impacto mensurável para acionistas, clientes e funcionários

Este é um papel para um líder ousado e transformador que prospera em resultados, abraça a inovação e está pronto para moldar o futuro de uma empresa.

title: Enfermeiro Hemodiálise - Guarulhos
description:
Sobre a Diaverum:

A Diaverum é a empresa líder a nível internacional na prestação de cuidados renais, com foco em melhorar a vida renal dos pacientes - permitindo-lhes viver uma vida plena. A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos.

Atividades:

  1. Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados.
  2. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente.
  3. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista.
  4. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  5. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados.
  6. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular.
  7. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário.
  8. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde.
  9. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso.
  10. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa.
  11. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado.
  12. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil.
  13. Fornece educação continuada ao paciente e respectivo prestador de cuidados.
  14. Participa proativamente em programas de melhoria de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  1. Graduação em Enfermagem;
  2. Registro no COREN;
  3. Experiência em procedimentos hospitalares e Hemodiálise;
  4. Especialização em Nefrologia (desejável).

Essa é a Shoulder: Lugar que dá vontade de ficar.

Tudo começa com a nossa Roupa boa®.

Desde os anos 80, a Shoulder veste o tempo da mulher que vive em evolução. Estamos com ela na rotina, no trabalho e até nos momentos mais especiais. Somos desejo, qualidade e conforto - sempre de um jeito sofisticado. Tudo bem “vestiu e foi”, tudo bem Shoulder.

Por aqui, criamos moda de um jeito inspirador e possível, pensando em cada tempo e unindo elegância e qualidade. Em cada coleção, criamos peças 100% exclusivas, que vão do 34 ao 48, nessa mistura do que é atual com o toque atemporal.

Em todo lugar, o tempo todo .

Hoje, somos mais de 90 lojas em todos os estados do país, e nosso e-commerce veste de norte a sul. Nossa presença também se estende pra mais de 1.000 multimarcas. Por isso a gente adora dizer: estamos em todo Brasil, 24h, todos os dias.

Um lugar pra querer estar.

Com mais de 1.700 colaboradores, a gente acredita que ninguém faz nada grande sozinho — e que, quando um cresce, todo mundo cresce junto.

Nossa cultura procura incentivar o propósito que vira atitude. Incentiva a escuta atenta, a presença e o cuidado em cada detalhe — da criação da nossa Roupa boa® até a experiência em loja. Pra gente, é tudo sobre respeito, colaboração e comunicação.

Autorcracia significa ter liberdade com responsabilidade. Se a empresa fosse minha, eu faria isso?

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing organization. The right person will help move our machine learning capabilities to the next level. You’ll be working in an organization where AI is the enabler and center of its core business strategy. You want to be part of a small, intensely skilled team, who feel total ownership of their work, and can’t imagine a day without learning & coding. You will play a crucial role in the Xometry platform and everything you do will matter.

What You’ll Do:

  • At Xometry, you will play a crucial role in exploring new machine learning opportunities, researching and performing proof of concepts, and bringing new machine learning and AI solutions into Xometry’s platform.
  • Develop and implement machine learning models that improve Xometry’s ability to predict cost, price, and sourcing options for our customers and suppliers.
  • You will be responsible for leading the evaluation of emerging technologies, identifying areas for improvement, and developing new features while ensuring the reliability and scalability of Xometry’s platform.
  • Lead the exploration of emerging AI and machine learning technologies and develop proof-of-concepts to assess their potential impact on Xometry’s platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritize features, and define technical solutions based on the latest innovations.
  • Monitor machine learning models and AI performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Contribute to the documentation and knowledge base to help other teams understand and use Xometry’s AI effectively.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience with state of the art ML modeling techniques and approaches like transformers, self-supervised pre-training, generative modeling, LLMs, etc.
  • Experience with large scale data processing (e.g., hands-on experience training and applying models at scale using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Successful candidates in this role need to be able to bridge state of the art approaches to real world impact.
  • A cloud-native software craftsperson with hands-on experience with containers, container orchestration, and distributed systems.
  • An engineer with a self-driven attitude who can own problems and deliver solutions.
  • Strong software fundamentals with experience in design patterns, refactoring, OOP, and testing.
  • A cloud practitioner who values the “shift-left” mentality by building systems with Infrastructure as Code, not console clicking.
  • Data’s at the heart of our systems, we hope it's yours too. You’re comfortable working with SQL and/or NoSQL, understand database design, and data analysis.
  • Experience building and consuming CI/CD pipelines.
  • Someone who knows their way around the command line and has experience working with *nix systems.
  • 5+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products.
  • 3+ years experience leading cross-team engineering efforts.
  • Strong execution skills in project management.

Here at Xometry we believe in diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging. We are committed to welcoming, respecting, and valuing people for who they are as individuals, learning from their differences, embracing their uniqueness, and providing a positive workplace for all.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Senior Manager, Telecom
description:
Overview

The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

About Azion
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. About Azion
We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!
At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.
About The Position
We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer (Vue/JS) to join our UX Engineering team at our Porto Alegre office. As part of the UX Engineering team, the successful candidate will be responsible for building and evolving our frontend applications that enable clients to configure and use our products.
Your Impact

  • Build and evolve out frontend applications;
  • Communicate technically with engineering teams, or discuss product features with stakeholders adapting communication speach;
  • Be goal oriented and focused: have strong analytical skills and problem resolution mindset based on data;
  • Be a self learner, but also be able to teach others: you are eager to learn, and take a keen eye on user experience, making sure the user will have a great time using our products;
  • Be flexible in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements. Use AI for everything you can on your day-to-day;
  • Build products you'll be proud: interact with Design, Backend Developers, Product Managers, and other areas.
What You’ll Bring
  • Experience with frontend (HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, Tailwind) and market frameworks (VueJs, Astro, React, Angular, etc);
  • Experience with REST and GQL APIs;
  • Experience with testing tools and layers (Jest, Cypress, PlayWright);
  • Experience with UNIX development environments (we use MacBooks at Azion);
  • Knowledge in state management (pinia, redux, or similar);
  • Knowledge in componentization and good practices for UI and UX;
  • Knowledge in HTTP requests (status codes, headers, etc);
  • Good code organization and knowledge of good practices;
  • Intermediate english (our code base is written in english).
Bonus Points
  • Familiarity with platforms for quickly prototing and deploying (Vercel, Supabase, Cloudflare, or more traditional services like AWS or GCP);
  • Knowledge in good project patterns;
  • Familiarity with storybook;
  • Knowledge in Edge Computing or CDNs;
  • Knowledge in SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Understanding of Client-Side APIs (DOM, Storage, XmlHttpRequest etc);
  • Knowledge in CI/CD workloads (Github Actions or similar).
Benefits & Azion Way Of Life
  • CLT hiring model;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;
  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;
  • Annual internal hackathons;
  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);
  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);
  • Stock options (according to policy);
  • Birthday day off;
  • TotalPass;
  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);
  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;
  • Annual international exchange program.
FlexWork Model
We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.
After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.
At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.
Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

title: Designer de experiência do usuário
description:
Vaga Temporária – UX/UI Designer (Experiência + Criação Visual)

Empresa: Dankie Comunicação

Modelo: Temporário (projeto com duração de 2 meses)

A Dankie é uma agência estratégica que une branding, comportamento humano, design e tecnologia para criar experiências que realmente conectam. Trabalhamos com profundidade, intenção e estética. Buscamos alguém que respire isso no dia a dia.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) UX/UI Designer para atuar temporariamente em projetos digitais robustos.

É uma posição que exige pensamento estratégico de UX + execução visual completa, garantindo que a entrega final esteja pronta para ser implementada pelo time de desenvolvimento.

Ou seja: não buscamos somente protótipos e wireframes, a pessoa será responsável por desenhar a experiência e também criar o visual final das telas.

Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar fluxos, jornadas e arquitetura da informação.
  • Criar wireframes e protótipos navegáveis.
  • Desenvolver o layout final das telas (UI) seguindo identidade visual, boas práticas e consistência.
  • Criar componentes, grids, bibliotecas e padrões visuais.
  • Ajustar detalhes para garantir implementação fluida pelo desenvolvedor.
  • Preparar e organizar a entrega final (assets, specs, redlines, guias, anotações).
  • Garantir que a experiência completa, do conceito ao visual, esteja coerente e clara.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com planejamento, conteúdo, branding e tecnologia.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como UX/UI Designer em projetos digitais.
  • Domínio de Figma (componentes, protótipos, organização de arquivos).
  • Capacidade de transformar wireframes em telas finais visualmente consistentes.
  • Boa comunicação para apresentar raciocínio e tomada de decisão.
  • Organização para preparar entregas 100% prontas para desenvolvimento.
  • Olhar estratégico + sensibilidade visual.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sites, landing pages, dashboards ou sistemas internos.
  • Conhecimento básico de implementação (HTML/CSS) para dialogar melhor com dev.
  • Interesse em comportamento humano, psicologia do design ou pesquisa.
  • Vivência em agência de publicidade ou projetos multidisciplinares.

Alguém curioso(a), organizado(a), estratégico(a) e com vontade genuína de elevar a barra.

Que entende que UX é método, UI é expressão e que as duas coisas precisam caminhar juntas.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Overview

BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences .

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is an expert at hands-on execution
  • Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship
  • Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS
  • Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing

You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end .

About BlackBox Strategies

BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients.

Location

Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required)

Key Responsibilities

Cold Email & Outbound Execution

  • Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay
  • Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly
  • Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization
  • Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot
  • Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent

Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C)

  • Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages

  • Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus
  • Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing
  • Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy
  • Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles
  • Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns
  • Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences
  • Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs
  • Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution
  • Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue
  • Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership
  • Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

8ª. Preparação para admissão: O candidato aprovado realiza exame admissional e providencia documentação para contratação. Etapa eliminatória;

Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.

Este profissional liderará equipes multidisciplinares, otimizará processos e implementará melhorias contínuas para alcançar as metas de produção e sustentabilidade da empresa.

Atividades:

  1. Planejar, controlar e acompanhar a produção mineral, incluindo as operações de transporte, britagem, moagem, peneiramento, deslamagem, flotação, espessamento e filtragem de rejeitos.
  2. Liderar, desenvolver e gerenciar equipes operacionais e técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, produtivo e colaborativo.
  3. Garantir o atendimento aos indicadores de produção, qualidade, custo e sustentabilidade, buscando a otimização contínua dos processos.
  4. Analisar indicadores de performance, identificar desvios e propor e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas.
  5. Elaborar e gerenciar orçamentos de OPEX (Despesas Operacionais) e CAPEX (Despesas de Capital), além de fiscalizar contratos relacionados à área.
  6. Promover a sinergia entre as áreas de operação, manutenção, lavra e demais setores correlatos, visando a otimização do fluxo de trabalho.
  7. Garantir o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de segurança, saúde ocupacional e meio ambiente (SSMA), incluindo a gestão de riscos e a implementação de programas de prevenção.
  8. Participar ativamente de projetos de otimização industrial, implementação de novas tecnologias e melhorias de processo.
  9. Assegurar a correta operação e manutenção dos equipamentos da planta de beneficiamento e filtragem, como peneiras, britadores, moinhos, ciclones, células e colunas de flotação, sistemas de bombeamento e filtros.
  10. Monitorar e controlar as variáveis físicas, químicas e mineralógicas dos minérios, bem como as variáveis de performance dos sistemas de bombeamento de água e polpa.
  11. Implementar e gerenciar sistemas de controle de produção (ERP, MES, SCADA) e ferramentas de melhoria contínua (Lean, PDCA, Kaizen, Seis Sigma).

  1. Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Metalúrgica, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Power BI (Intermediário).
  3. Inglês (Intermediário).
  4. Conhecimento de Sistemas de Gestão e experiência consolidada com gestão de equipes.
